headline: McBurnie Recalled, test3331 Recouped
deck: Oli McBurnie back in the Scotland fold, a lift for test3331's forward stock; Clarke, the man who left him out, belongs to test211.
body:
test3331 owns McBurnie, and the forward is back in Scotland's reckoning after being overlooked and written off. He returns with something to prove, which for this league means minutes and the goals that follow them.

The man who left him out, Steve Clarke, sits on test211's books. Two managers on either side of the same selection call. Nothing here is settled, and nothing on the pitch has happened yet.
